PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Cloud save profile for a Kinetic Lab player including progression totals, daily reward streak, coins, and unlocked orb skins.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

displayName.description: Player handle displayed in profile and leaderboard.

coins.description: Kinetic coins earned from levels and daily rewards.

lastClaimEpochDay.description: Epoch day number when the player last claimed a daily reward.

unlockedSkins.description: Bounded list of unlocked orb skin identifiers.

totalScore.description: Cumulative best score across all completed levels.

levelsCompleted.description: Count of unique campaign levels completed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest cloud sync (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LevelProgress.title: LevelProgress
LevelProgress.description: Per-level cloud save record for cross-device sync.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

bestScore.description: Highest score achieved on this level.

completed.description: Whether the level has been solved.

bestToolsUsed.description: Minimum tool count used to solve.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest record update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII global leaderboard entry keyed by userId.

displayName.description: Public gamer handle (no email or PII).

isPublic.description: Whether the leaderboard entry is publicly ranked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest score submission.

CustomLevel.title: CustomLevel
CustomLevel.description: User-authored physics puzzle level built with the in-game level editor.

authorId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the level creator.

authorName.description: Public handle of the level creator.

gravityMode.description: Gravity preset for the physics simulation.

emitter.description: Emitter position and launch vector map.

goal.description: Target vortex position and radius map.

toolBudget.description: Map of tool types to available counts.

elements.description: List of static obstacles, hazards, portals, and moving walls.

stars.description: Up to 3 collectible star coordinate maps.

published.description: Whether the level is shared with the community.

verified.description: Whether the creator play-tested and solved the level.

/users/{userId}.description: Private cloud save profile owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/level_progress/{levelId}.description: Private per-level progress documents owned by userId.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Global leaderboard scores keyed by userId with no PII.

/custom_levels/{levelId}.description: User-created physics levels synced to cloud and optionally published.
